misc: Bags Miura irons and is rumoured to sleep with them.
biography: Miso, representing Hirsala Golf, has been a steadfast competitor in the Hector Trophée, participating in a remarkable ten editions of this prestigious annual event. His decade-long involvement underscores a deep commitment to the tournament's unique format and competitive challenges.

During his extensive tenure, Miso has demonstrated his capacity for excellence in the pair competition. He has proudly lifted the coveted Hector Trophée on one occasion, a testament to his strategic insight and collaborative play. While the individual Victor Trophy has yet to grace his mantel, his contribution to a championship-winning duo firmly establishes his place in the event's history.

Miso's meticulous approach to golf extends notably to his equipment, epitomized by his choice of Miura irons. This dedication to precision and artisanal craftsmanship in his tools is so profound that it is often whispered he holds them in such high regard, he might even sleep with them. Such a commitment to the finest details reflects a player who understands the subtle nuances that separate contenders from champions.

While Miso remains an active figure within the broader sphere of Hector events, it has been confirmed that he will not be joining the field for the upcoming Hector Trophée 2026. Nevertheless, his significant past achievements and distinctive approach to the game suggest that any future return would be met with keen anticipation from the golf community, eager to witness another chapter from this dedicated competitor.
